definition_en: by a large amount; considerably
example_en: Prices have risen substantially this year.
example_zh: 今年物价大幅上涨。

definition_en: to provide evidence that proves something is true
example_en: He could not substantiate his claim with any documents.
example_zh: 他拿不出任何文件来证实自己的说法。

definition_en: a thing or person used in place of another; to use in place of
example_en: Honey can be used as a substitute for sugar.
example_zh: 蜂蜜可以用来代替糖。

definition_en: the surface or material on which something lives or grows
example_en: Young corals need a hard substrate to attach to.
example_zh: 幼年珊瑚需要坚硬的基底来附着。

definition_en: to include something as part of a larger group or category
example_en: Several small schools were subsumed into one large one.
example_zh: 几所小学校被并入了一所大学校。

definition_en: not obvious; delicate and hard to notice or describe
example_en: There is a subtle difference between the two shades of blue.
example_zh: 这两种蓝色之间有细微的差别。

definition_en: relating to regions near the tropics, with warm weather
example_en: Oranges grow well in a subtropical climate.
example_zh: 橙子在亚热带气候下长得很好。

definition_en: making you think of something; giving a hint of it
example_en: The marks on the bone are suggestive of tool use.
example_zh: 骨头上的痕迹表明曾使用过工具。

definition_en: right or appropriate for a particular purpose or person
example_en: The dry soil is well suited to growing grapes.
example_zh: 这种干燥的土壤很适合种葡萄。

definition_en: to call something up or bring it into being; to order someone to come
example_en: The music summons memories of my childhood.
example_zh: 这段音乐唤起了我童年的回忆。

definition_en: a huge landmass formed when most of Earth's continents were joined
example_en: Pangaea was a supercontinent that later broke apart.
example_zh: 泛大陆是一块后来分裂开的超大陆。

definition_en: better in quality than something else
example_en: This cloth is superior to the cheaper one.
example_zh: 这种布料比便宜的那种好。

definition_en: the state of being better than something else
example_en: Tests proved the superiority of the new design.
example_zh: 测试证明了新设计的优越性。

definition_en: not explainable by the laws of nature; ghosts, magic and similar things
example_en: The story is full of supernatural events.
example_zh: 这个故事里满是超自然的事件。

definition_en: to take the place of something older or less effective
example_en: Email has largely superseded the letter.
example_zh: 电子邮件在很大程度上取代了书信。

definition_en: to take the place of someone or something
example_en: Cars supplanted horses as the main form of transport.
example_zh: 汽车取代马成为主要的交通工具。

definition_en: something added to complete or improve another thing; to add to
example_en: The pictures are a useful supplement to the text.
example_zh: 这些图片是对文字的有益补充。

definition_en: likely to be affected or harmed by something
definition_zh: 易受影响的；容易遭受……的
example_en: Young trees are susceptible to frost.
example_zh: 幼树容易遭受霜冻。

definition_en: a belief that someone has done something wrong, without proof
example_en: He was arrested on suspicion of theft.
example_zh: 他因涉嫌盗窃被捕。

definition_en: to keep something alive or in existence; to support
example_en: The lake sustains thousands of birds.
example_zh: 这个湖养育着成千上万只鸟。

definition_en: able to continue for a long time without harming the environment
example_en: The village uses sustainable farming methods.
example_zh: 这个村子采用可持续的耕作方式。

definition_en: a small piece of cloth used as a sample
example_en: The tailor showed us swatches of wool in ten colors.
example_zh: 裁缝给我们看了十种颜色的羊毛样片。

definition_en: to move around quickly in circles
example_en: Leaves swirled in the wind.
example_zh: 树叶在风中打着旋。

definition_en: a unit of sound in a word, containing one vowel sound
example_en: The word "water" has two syllables.
example_zh: “water”这个词有两个音节。

definition_en: (of a relationship) in which two different living things help each other
example_en: Bees and flowers have a symbiotic relationship.
example_zh: 蜜蜂和花是共生关系。

definition_en: having two halves that are exactly the same in shape and size
example_en: A butterfly's wings are symmetrical.
example_zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀是对称的。

definition_en: the quality of having parts that match each other in size and shape
example_en: The garden was designed with perfect symmetry.
example_zh: 这座花园的设计完全对称。

definition_en: relating to or written for a large orchestra
example_en: The concert included two symphonic works.
example_zh: 音乐会上演奏了两部交响作品。

definition_en: the rules for arranging words into sentences
example_en: English syntax usually puts the subject before the verb.
example_zh: 英语句法通常把主语放在动词之前。

definition_en: the combining of different ideas or things into a whole
example_en: The book is a synthesis of history and science.
example_zh: 这本书综合了历史与科学。

definition_en: in a careful, organized way that follows a plan
example_en: She systematically checked every drawer.
example_zh: 她有条不紊地检查了每一个抽屉。

definition_en: affecting the whole of a system, not just one part
example_en: The report found systemic problems in the school's funding.
example_zh: 报告发现学校的经费存在系统性问题。

definition_en: to make a determined effort to deal with a problem
example_en: The city is tackling its traffic problem.
example_zh: 这座城市正在着手解决交通问题。

definition_en: a young frog or toad that lives in water and has a tail
example_en: The pond is full of tadpoles in spring.
example_zh: 春天池塘里满是蝌蚪。

definition_en: real and able to be seen, touched or measured
example_en: The program has brought tangible benefits to the town.
example_zh: 这个项目给镇上带来了实实在在的好处。

definition_en: a bitter substance found in some plants, such as tea leaves and acorns
example_en: Strong tea tastes bitter because of its tannin.
example_zh: 浓茶发苦是因为含有单宁。

definition_en: a heavy cloth with pictures or patterns woven into it
example_en: A large tapestry hung on the castle wall.
example_zh: 城堡的墙上挂着一幅大挂毯。

definition_en: the system by which a government collects money from people and businesses
example_en: Schools are paid for through taxation.
example_zh: 学校的经费来自税收。

definition_en: relating to the movement of the large plates that form Earth's surface
example_en: Earthquakes are caused by tectonic activity.
example_zh: 地震是由地壳构造活动引起的。

definition_en: a person's nature as shown in how they usually behave or react
example_en: She has a calm temperament.
example_zh: 她性情平和。

definition_en: mild and not extreme; (of a person) calm and self-controlled
definition_zh: 温和的；（气候）温带的；有节制的
example_en: Britain has a temperate climate.
example_zh: 英国属于温带气候。

definition_en: to make someone want to do something (tempting, adj.: attractive)
example_en: It is tempting to skip breakfast when you are late.
example_zh: 快迟到的时候，人很容易想不吃早饭。

definition_en: a person who pays rent to live in or use a building
example_en: The tenants complained about the broken heating.
example_zh: 租户们投诉暖气坏了。

definition_en: expressing a strong, one-sided opinion in a way meant to persuade
example_en: The article is tendentious and ignores the other side.
example_zh: 这篇文章带有倾向性，完全无视另一方的观点。

definition_en: gentle, kind and loving
example_en: He gave the child a tender smile.
example_zh: 他对孩子温柔地笑了笑。

definition_en: the period of time during which someone holds a job or office
example_en: During her tenure as mayor, three schools were built.
example_zh: 在她担任市长期间，建了三所学校。

definition_en: one of a series of flat areas cut like steps into a hillside for farming
example_en: Rice grows on terraces cut into the hills.
example_zh: 水稻种在山坡上开出的梯田里。

definition_en: the land in an area, considered in terms of its natural features
example_en: The rocky terrain made walking slow.
example_zh: 地形多石，走起来很慢。

definition_en: living on or relating to land rather than water or air
example_en: Frogs are both aquatic and terrestrial animals.
example_zh: 青蛙既是水生动物也是陆生动物。

definition_en: cloth made by weaving or knitting
example_en: The town was famous for its cotton textiles.
example_zh: 这个镇以棉纺织品闻名。

definition_en: relating to a written text
example_en: The essay gives textual evidence for each claim.
example_zh: 这篇文章为每个论点都提供了文本依据。

definition_en: (of a roof or house) covered with dried straw, reeds or leaves
example_en: The village is full of thatched cottages.
example_zh: 村子里到处是茅草屋。

definition_en: a person who studies religion and religious beliefs
example_en: The theologian wrote several books about faith.
example_zh: 这位神学家写了好几本关于信仰的书。

definition_en: to suggest an explanation or set of ideas about something
example_en: Scientists theorize that the moon was once part of Earth.
example_zh: 科学家推测月球曾是地球的一部分。

definition_en: helping to treat an illness or to make someone feel better
example_en: Many people find gardening therapeutic.
example_zh: 许多人觉得园艺有疗愈作用。

definition_en: as a result of the action just mentioned; in that way
example_en: He locked the gate, thereby keeping the dogs inside.
example_zh: 他锁上了大门，这样狗就出不去了。

definition_en: to grow, develop or be successful
example_en: Tomatoes thrive in warm, sunny places.
example_zh: 番茄在温暖向阳的地方长得很好。

definition_en: a strong, regular beat; to beat strongly
example_en: She felt the throb of the engine through the floor.
example_zh: 她透过地板感觉到发动机的震动。

definition_en: to make a low, steady, continuous sound
example_en: Rain thrummed on the roof all night.
example_zh: 雨在屋顶上嗒嗒地响了一整夜。

definition_en: willingness to accept behavior or ideas that you do not like or agree with
example_en: The teacher has little tolerance for lateness.
example_zh: 这位老师不太能容忍迟到。

definition_en: the quality of being poisonous, or the degree to which something is
example_en: The frog's bright color warns of its toxicity.
example_zh: 这种青蛙鲜艳的颜色是在警告它有毒。

definition_en: a balance in which you give up one good thing to get another (also written tradeoff)
example_en: There is a trade-off between speed and accuracy.
example_zh: 速度和准确度之间需要取舍。

definition_en: a particular quality or feature of a person, animal or plant
example_en: Eye color is an inherited trait.
example_zh: 眼睛的颜色是遗传特征。

definition_en: the path that something follows as it moves or develops
example_en: The ball followed a curved trajectory.
example_zh: 球沿着一条弧形轨迹飞行。

definition_en: calm, quiet and peaceful
example_en: We spent the afternoon beside a tranquil lake.
example_zh: 我们在一个宁静的湖边度过了下午。

definition_en: crossing or involving the Atlantic Ocean
example_en: The first transatlantic flight took many hours.
example_zh: 第一次横跨大西洋的飞行花了很多个小时。

definition_en: the system of buses and trains that carries people; the act of passing across something
example_en: The city is improving its public transit.
example_zh: 这座城市正在改善公共交通。

definition_en: the act of passing something from one place, person or thing to another
example_en: Hand washing reduces the transmission of disease.
example_zh: 洗手可以减少疾病的传播。

definition_en: to move something, such as a plant or organ, to a new place
example_en: We transplanted the young trees into the garden.
example_zh: 我们把小树移栽到了花园里。

definition_en: to change the order or position of things; to move into a different setting
example_en: The editor transposed the two paragraphs.
example_zh: 编辑把这两段的顺序对调了。

definition_en: to step or walk on something
example_en: Please do not tread on the flowers.
example_zh: 请不要踩到花。

definition_en: the crime of being disloyal to your country or ruler
example_en: The general was accused of treason.
example_zh: 那位将军被控叛国。

definition_en: a long, serious piece of writing on a particular subject
example_en: He wrote a treatise on the art of swimming.
example_zh: 他写了一部关于游泳技艺的专著。

definition_en: to shake slightly because of fear, cold or excitement
example_en: Her hands trembled as she opened the letter.
example_zh: 她拆信时双手发抖。

definition_en: very great in size, amount or degree
example_en: The city has seen tremendous growth in ten years.
example_zh: 十年间这座城市发展迅猛。

definition_en: a river or stream that flows into a larger river
example_en: The river has several tributaries.
example_zh: 这条河有好几条支流。

definition_en: to cause something to start or happen
example_en: The smoke triggered the fire alarm.
example_zh: 烟雾触发了火警警报。

definition_en: a unit of poetic rhythm with one strong syllable followed by one weak syllable
definition_zh: 扬抑格（一重一轻的音步）
example_en: The word "garden" is a trochee: GAR-den.
example_zh: “garden”这个词是扬抑格：先重后轻。

definition_en: (past participle of tread) stepped or walked on
example_en: The grass had been trodden flat by the crowd.
example_zh: 草地被人群踩平了。

definition_en: an idea, image or theme that is used again and again in stories or art
example_en: The lost twin is a familiar trope in adventure films.
example_zh: 失散的双胞胎是冒险片里常见的桥段。

definition_en: relating to feeding and to the levels of a food chain
example_en: Plants form the lowest trophic level of a food web.
example_zh: 植物处于食物网的最低营养级。

definition_en: made so that all its sizes and distances keep the same proportions as the real thing
example_en: The museum has a true-to-scale model of the ship.
example_zh: 博物馆里有一艘按真实比例制作的船模。

definition_en: the thick underground part of a plant such as a potato or yam
example_en: The potato is a tuber that grows underground.
example_zh: 土豆是长在地下的块茎。

definition_en: relating to the eardrum (the tympanic membrane)
example_en: Sound makes the tympanic membrane vibrate.
example_zh: 声音使鼓膜振动。

definition_en: (of light) having a wavelength too short for humans to see
example_en: Sunscreen protects skin from ultraviolet light.
example_zh: 防晒霜保护皮肤免受紫外线伤害。

definition_en: missing and not explained
definition_zh: 下落不明的；未得到解释的
example_en: The unaccounted-for money was never found.
example_zh: 那笔去向不明的钱一直没有找到。

definition_en: not changed
example_en: The recipe has remained unaltered for a century.
example_zh: 这个配方一个世纪以来一直没变。

definition_en: clear and able to be understood in only one way
example_en: The sign gave an unambiguous warning.
example_zh: 这块牌子给出了明确的警告。

definition_en: not following what is usual or traditional
example_en: She has an unconventional way of teaching math.
example_zh: 她教数学的方法与众不同。

definition_en: to discover something that was hidden or buried
example_en: Workers uncovered an old well under the floor.
example_zh: 工人在地板下发现了一口古井。

definition_en: not valued as highly as it deserves
example_en: The film was underappreciated when it first came out.
example_zh: 这部电影刚上映时没有得到应有的重视。

definition_en: the failure to value something as highly as it deserves
definition_zh: 未得到应有的重视；被低估
example_en: The writer suffered from years of underappreciation.
example_zh: 这位作家多年来一直被低估。

definition_en: to be the basis or hidden cause of something
definition_zh: 构成……的基础；是……的深层原因
example_en: A fear of failure underlies his refusal to try.
example_zh: 他不肯尝试的深层原因是害怕失败。

definition_en: basic and important, but not always easy to notice
example_en: Doctors treated the underlying cause of the pain.
example_zh: 医生针对疼痛的根本原因进行了治疗。

definition_en: to make something weaker or less effective, often gradually
example_en: Constant criticism undermined her confidence.
example_zh: 不断的批评削弱了她的自信。

definition_en: to emphasize the importance of something
example_en: The accident underscores the need for better lighting.
example_zh: 这起事故凸显了改善照明的必要性。

definition_en: (past participle: undertaken) to begin to do a task or take responsibility for it
definition_zh: 承担；着手做（过去分词 undertaken）
example_en: The repairs were undertaken by a local company.
example_zh: 维修工作由一家本地公司承担。

definition_en: not able or not careful enough to judge the quality of things
definition_zh: 不善鉴别的；没有眼光的
example_en: An undiscerning reader might miss the author's humor.
example_zh: 缺乏鉴别力的读者可能看不出作者的幽默。

definition_en: accepted by everyone; not doubted or questioned
example_en: She is the undisputed leader of the team.
example_zh: 她是队里公认的领袖。

definition_en: not touched, changed or interrupted
definition_zh: 未受干扰的；原封不动的
example_en: The tomb lay undisturbed for three thousand years.
example_zh: 这座墓三千年来一直没有被人动过。

definition_en: to find something by digging it out of the ground; to discover
example_en: Farmers unearthed a clay jar full of coins.
example_zh: 农民们挖出了一个装满钱币的陶罐。

definition_en: to develop or become known gradually
example_en: We watched the story unfold on the news.
example_zh: 我们在新闻里看着事情一步步发展。

definition_en: an animal with hooves, such as a deer, horse or cow
example_en: Deer and elk are ungulates.
example_zh: 鹿和马鹿都是有蹄类动物。

definition_en: not stopped or slowed by anything
definition_zh: 畅通无阻的；不受阻碍的
example_en: Traffic moved unimpeded through the tunnel.
example_zh: 车辆在隧道里畅通无阻。

definition_en: without special knowledge or experience of something; people like this
definition_zh: 外行的；不了解内情的（人）
example_en: To the uninitiated, the rules of the game seem confusing.
example_zh: 对外行来说，这项运动的规则显得很难懂。

definition_en: by everyone or in every case
example_en: The rule is not universally accepted.
example_zh: 这条规则并没有被普遍接受。

definition_en: without being aware of what you are doing
example_en: He unknowingly carried the virus home.
example_zh: 他在不知情的情况下把病毒带回了家。

definition_en: not blocked by anything
example_en: The balcony has an unobstructed view of the sea.
example_zh: 阳台上看海毫无遮挡。

definition_en: in a way that cannot be known in advance
example_en: The wind changed direction unpredictably.
example_zh: 风向变得难以预料。

definition_en: (of a syllable) spoken without emphasis
example_en: In "about," the first syllable is unstressed.
example_zh: 在“about”里，第一个音节是非重读的。

definition_en: not able to continue at the same rate or level
definition_zh: 不可持续的；难以维持的
example_en: Such fast spending is unsustainable.
example_zh: 花钱这么快是维持不下去的。

definition_en: impossible to express properly in another language
example_en: Some jokes are untranslatable.
example_zh: 有些笑话是没法翻译的。

definition_en: relating to a town or city
example_en: Urban areas are usually noisier than the countryside.
example_zh: 城市地区通常比乡村吵。

definition_en: to use something for a practical purpose
example_en: The farm utilizes solar power to pump water.
example_zh: 这个农场利用太阳能抽水。

definition_en: empty; not being used or lived in
example_en: The house has been vacant for a year.
example_zh: 这栋房子已经空置一年了。

definition_en: without success or result; useless
example_en: They made a vain attempt to save the tree.
example_zh: 他们试图救活那棵树，但徒劳无功。

definition_en: to prove or confirm that something is true or correct
example_en: The experiment validated the scientists' prediction.
example_zh: 实验验证了科学家们的预测。

definition_en: great courage, especially in battle
example_en: The soldier received a medal for valor.
example_zh: 这名士兵因英勇获得了一枚奖章。

definition_en: to disappear suddenly or completely
example_en: The fog vanished as the sun rose.
example_zh: 太阳一升起，雾就散了。

definition_en: a mass of tiny drops of liquid in the air; a gas formed from a liquid
example_en: Water vapor rose from the hot spring.
example_zh: 温泉上升腾着水汽。

definition_en: a form of something that differs slightly from others of the same kind
example_en: This is a regional variant of the same dish.
example_zh: 这是同一道菜的一种地方做法。

definition_en: the plants that grow in a particular area
example_en: Thick vegetation covers the hillside.
example_zh: 山坡上覆盖着茂密的植被。

definition_en: a soft, thick cloth; (adj.) soft, deep and smooth like this cloth
definition_zh: 天鹅绒；天鹅绒般柔滑的
example_en: The night sky was a deep velvet blue.
example_zh: 夜空是天鹅绒般深邃的蓝色。

definition_en: respected because of great age, history or character
definition_zh: 历史悠久而受人尊敬的
example_en: The university is a venerable institution founded in 1500.
example_zh: 这所大学创立于 1500 年，历史悠久，备受尊敬。

definition_en: the movement of fresh air into and through a room or building
example_en: Open the windows to improve ventilation.
example_zh: 打开窗户来改善通风。

definition_en: the place where an event happens or where something is published
example_en: The concert was moved to a larger venue.
example_zh: 音乐会改到了一个更大的场地。

definition_en: the act of checking that something is true or correct
example_en: The bank asked for verification of his address.
example_zh: 银行要求核实他的住址。

definition_en: poetry; a group of lines forming one part of a poem or song
example_en: The story is told in verse rather than in prose.
example_zh: 这个故事是用诗而不是散文写成的。

definition_en: an animal that has a backbone; having a backbone
example_en: Fish, birds and humans are all vertebrates.
example_zh: 鱼、鸟和人都是脊椎动物。

definition_en: the ability to succeed or to continue working
example_en: Experts doubt the economic viability of the mine.
example_zh: 专家怀疑这座矿在经济上是否可行。

definition_en: able to work or succeed; practical
example_en: Solar power is a viable option for the village.
example_zh: 太阳能对这个村子来说是可行的选择。

definition_en: very great skill, especially in music or art
example_en: The violinist amazed the audience with her virtuosity.
example_zh: 这位小提琴手以精湛的技艺震撼了观众。

definition_en: how thick a liquid is and how slowly it flows
example_en: Honey has a higher viscosity than water.
example_zh: 蜂蜜的黏度比水高。

definition_en: how far or how clearly you can see
example_en: Fog reduced visibility to a few meters.
example_zh: 大雾使能见度降到只有几米。

definition_en: energy and liveliness
example_en: Even at eighty, she was full of vitality.
example_zh: 即使到了八十岁，她仍然充满活力。

definition_en: very bright in color; producing clear, strong pictures in the mind
example_en: He gave a vivid description of the storm.
example_zh: 他把那场暴风雨描述得很生动。

definition_en: relating to the voice or to singing
example_en: The song features a powerful vocal performance.
example_zh: 这首歌有一段极具力量的人声演唱。

definition_en: an empty space or hole
example_en: Water filled the voids between the rocks.
example_zh: 水填满了岩石之间的空隙。

definition_en: (of a substance) changing easily into a gas; also, likely to change suddenly
definition_zh: 易挥发的；易变的；不稳定的
example_en: Gasoline is a volatile liquid.
example_zh: 汽油是一种易挥发的液体。

definition_en: a weakness that makes someone or something easy to harm
example_en: The test exposed a vulnerability in the system.
example_zh: 这次测试暴露了系统的一个弱点。

definition_en: to become gradually weaker, smaller or less important
example_en: Interest in the old game began to wane.
example_zh: 人们对这个老游戏的兴趣开始减退。

definition_en: to make something necessary or justified
definition_zh: 使有必要；证明……是正当的
example_en: The small error does not warrant such a strong reaction.
example_zh: 这么小的失误不值得如此强烈的反应。

definition_en: used water from homes, farms or factories
example_en: The plant cleans wastewater before it reaches the river.
example_zh: 这座处理厂在废水流入河流之前将其净化。

definition_en: a river, canal or other route that boats can travel along
example_en: The canal is a busy waterway.
example_zh: 这条运河是繁忙的水道。

definition_en: the distance between two waves of light or sound, which determines color or pitch
example_en: Red light has a longer wavelength than blue light.
example_zh: 红光的波长比蓝光长。

definition_en: a traveler, especially one who goes on foot
example_en: A tired wayfarer stopped at the inn for the night.
example_zh: 一位疲惫的旅人在客栈住了一夜。

definition_en: to fix something firmly by pushing it into a narrow space
example_en: The door was wedged shut with a piece of wood.
example_zh: 门被一块木头楔住，打不开了。

definition_en: the state of being healthy, happy and comfortable
example_en: Exercise improves both physical and mental well-being.
example_zh: 运动能改善身心健康。

definition_en: an area of land that is covered with shallow water for much of the year
example_en: Many birds nest in the wetland.
example_zh: 许多鸟在湿地筑巢。

definition_en: (formal) in which
example_en: It was a system wherein each worker had a vote.
example_zh: 那是一种每个工人都有投票权的制度。

definition_en: to sharpen; to make a feeling or desire stronger
example_en: The smell from the kitchen whetted my appetite.
example_zh: 厨房飘来的香味让我胃口大开。

definition_en: to hold and use a tool or weapon; to have and use power
example_en: The new mayor wields a great deal of influence.
example_zh: 新市长很有影响力。

definition_en: the state of being ready or happy to do something
example_en: He showed a willingness to learn from his mistakes.
example_zh: 他表现出愿意从错误中吸取教训。

definition_en: (old use) in addition; besides; at the same time
example_en: The inn was small and withal very comfortable.
example_zh: 这家客栈很小，同时也非常舒适。

definition_en: to take something back or away; to move back from a place or activity
example_en: She decided to withdraw from the race.
example_zh: 她决定退出比赛。

definition_en: to be strong enough not to be harmed by something
example_en: The bridge was built to withstand strong winds.
example_zh: 这座桥在建造时就考虑了要能抵御强风。

definition_en: the skill of making things from wood; things made of wood
example_en: He learned woodwork from his grandfather.
example_zh: 他跟祖父学了木工。

definition_en: causing worry
example_en: The sudden drop in bee numbers is worrisome.
example_zh: 蜜蜂数量骤减令人担忧。

definition_en: a metal tool for holding and turning nuts, bolts and pipes
example_en: The plumber tightened the pipe with a wrench.
example_zh: 水管工用扳手把管子拧紧。

definition_en: (old past form of work) made or shaped with skill
definition_zh: （work 的旧式过去分词）精心制成的
example_en: The gate was wrought from iron by a local smith.
example_zh: 这扇大门是当地铁匠用铁打造的。

definition_en: the amount of a crop that is produced; to produce a result
example_en: Good rain led to a high yield of wheat.
example_zh: 雨水充足，小麦产量很高。

definition_en: the yellow part in the middle of an egg
example_en: Separate the yolk from the white before mixing.
example_zh: 搅拌之前先把蛋黄和蛋清分开。

definition_en: tiny animals that drift in water and are eaten by fish
example_en: Small fish feed on zooplankton.
example_zh: 小鱼以浮游动物为食。
